title: The 5 Best Baby Monitors With No Wi-Fi Needed
h1: The 5 Best Baby Monitors With No Wi-Fi Needed
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for baby monitors with no wi-fi needed, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at baby monitors with no wi-fi needed using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Infant Optics DXR-8 Video Baby Monitor
products.blurb: Key specs: Non-Wi-Fi FHSS connection, no hacking risk, Interchangeable optical lens system, Pan, tilt and zoom camera.
strengths: Interchangeable lenses are unique among no-Wi-Fi models at this price
No subscription and no cloud account required, ever
limitations: 3.5-inch screen is on the smaller side
480p resolution is lower than any Wi-Fi competitor
No way to check the feed remotely if you leave the house
features: Non-Wi-Fi FHSS connection, no hacking risk
Two-way talk and automatic night vision

products.name: VTech VM919HD Video Baby Monitor
products.blurb: Key specs: 7-inch 720p screen on a dedicated parent unit, No Wi-Fi, secure FHSS transmission, 360-degree pan, 100-degree tilt, 4x zoom.
strengths: 7-inch screen is the largest dedicated display among no-Wi-Fi monitors
1000 ft rated range beats the DXR-8 and most Wi-Fi monitors' effective coverage
720p resolution is a step up from most non-Wi-Fi competitors
limitations: Bulkier parent unit than the DXR-8's more compact handheld
Fewer total ratings than the DXR-8, less long-term track record
No app, same as every no-Wi-Fi monitor, by design
features: 7-inch 720p screen on a dedicated parent unit
Up to 1000 ft open-air range and 15-hour battery

products.name: eufy Baby Monitor E21
strengths: Wi-Fi on/off switch for a private local-only mode

products.name: HelloBaby 5-Inch Baby Monitor with 2 Cameras
strengths: No Wi-Fi, app or account needed
Pan, tilt, zoom and two-way talk

products.name: HelloBaby HB6550 Baby Monitor with 3 Cameras
strengths: Three cameras for multiple rooms or twins
limitations: Switching between cameras on one screen

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
